# Maloney Law Group

> > A San Antonio-based personal injury and medical malpractice law firm specializing in birth injuries, with a track record of thousands of favorable verdicts and settlements.

Maloney Law Group is a Texas law firm founded by Erica and Dennis Maloney, focusing on medical malpractice claims and personal injury cases. The firm has extensive experience with birth injury cases, including cerebral palsy, brain damage, and delivery errors, and serves clients throughout the San Antonio area and surrounding communities.
